SELECT Y.TMNL_ID , Y.CKNCT_ID , Y.ALN_CD , Y.DOM_INTL_SE_CD , Y.CHKN_TYPE_CD , Y.MSTR_FLTNM , TO_DATE(Y.OPER_YMD || Y.STA_HM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') AS BGN_DT , TO_DATE(Y.OPER_YMD || Y.END_HM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') + CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(Y.STA_HM) > TO_NUMBER(Y.END_HM) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS END_DT FROM ( SELECT A.TMNL_ID , A.CKNCT_ID , A.ALN_CD , A.DOM_INTL_SE_CD , A.CHKN_TYPE_CD , A.MSTR_FLTNM , A.OPER_YMD , CASE WHEN A.EST_BGNG_HM IS NOT NULL AND A.EST_END_HM IS NOT NULL THEN A.EST_BGNG_HM ELSE A.LAST_BGNG_HM END AS STA_HM , CASE WHEN A.EST_BGNG_HM IS NOT NULL AND A.EST_END_HM IS NOT NULL THEN A.EST_END_HM ELSE A.LAST_END_HM END AS END_HM FROM GOOWN.TI_GO_CKNCT_DALY_ALOT A JOIN CAOWN.TN_CA_CKNCT CIC ON A.CKNCT_ID = CIC.CKNCT_ID AND A.TMNL_ID = CIC.TMNL_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND CIC.USE_YN = 'Y' AND CIC.CKNCT_USE_CRG_APLCN_TYPE_CD IN ('A', 'B') AND A.OPER_YMD BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{alotYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{alotYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.CKNCT_ID NOT LIKE 'X%' AND A.CKNCT_ID NOT LIKE 'Y%' AND A.CKNCT_ID NOT LIKE 'R%' AND A.CKNCT_ID NOT LIKE 'S%' ) Y WHERE Y.STA_HM != Y.END_HM

SELECT D.OPER_HR_CRLTN_SN, D.ELMNT_SN, D.TMNL_ID, D.FCLT_SE_CD, D.SORT_SEQ , D.PRD_SN, D.FCLTY_TYPE_ID, D.BSC_OPER_HR_YN, D.BGNG_YMD, D.END_YMD, D.OPER_BGNG_1_HR, D.OPER_END_1_HR FROM ( SELECT C.OPER_HR_CRLTN_SN, C.ELMNT_SN , B.TMNL_ID, B.FCLT_SE_CD, B.SORT_SEQ , C.PRD_SN, C.FCLTY_TYPE_ID, C.BSC_OPER_HR_YN , C.OPER_BGNG_YMD AS BGNG_YMD, NVL(C.OPER_END_YMD, '21001231') AS END_YMD , C.OPER_BGNG_1_HR, C.OPER_END_1_HR , MAX(C.OPER_HR_CRLTN_SN) OVER (PARTITION BY B.TMNL_ID, B.FCLT_SE_CD) AS LATEST_CRLTN_SN FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_ENTGT_DPTGT_OPER_HR_INFO A INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_ENTGT_DPTGT_OPER_HR_ELMNT B ON A.OPER_HR_CRLTN_SN = B.OPER_HR_CRLTN_SN INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_ENTGT_DPTGT_OPER_HR_MNG C ON A.OPER_HR_CRLTN_SN = C.OPER_HR_CRLTN_SN AND B.ELMNT_SN = C.ELMNT_SN WHERE A.OPER_HR_STTS_CD = 'DPL' AND REPLACE(NVL((SELECT DEP_ARR_YMD FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCHDL_ATRB WHERE SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID = #{rsrcNo} GROUP BY DEP_ARR_YMD), #{baseYmd}), '/', '') BETWEEN C.OPER_BGNG_YMD AND NVL(C.OPER_END_YMD, '21001231') ) D WHERE D.OPER_HR_CRLTN_SN = D.LATEST_CRLTN_SN

UNION ALL SELECT 'FlightSchedule', 'FS001', 'Operative Flight Schedule' , TO_CHAR(MAX(NVL(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, A.FRST_REG_DT)), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'), 'cols_FlightSchedule1' FROM GOOWN.TN_GO_GD_DATA A WHERE A.GD_SE_YMD = #{baseYmd}
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

UNION ALL SELECT 'PropertySet', 'PS' || A.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, 'Property Set' , TO_CHAR(NVL(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, A.FRST_REG_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'), 'cols_PropertySet' FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP A WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT 'PropertySet', M.PRPT_STNG_RSRC_ID, 'Property Set' , TO_CHAR(M.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'), 'cols_PropertySet' FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR M WHERE M.PRPT_STNG_RSRC_ID IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'GenericTable', 'CheckinType' || A.CKNCT_TYPE_ATRB_ID, 'Operative CheckinType' , TO_CHAR(NVL(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, A.FRST_REG_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'), 'cols_Type' FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_CKNCT_TYPE_MSTR A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL SELECT 'GenericTable', 'CheckinCounterServiceTime' || A.CKNCT_SRVC_ATRB_ID, 'Operative CheckinCounterServiceTime' , TO_CHAR(NVL(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, A.FRST_REG_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'), 'cols_ServiceTime' FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_CKNCT_SRVC_MSTR A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL SELECT 'GenericTable', 'FacilityOpeningTable_DepartureGate' || A.DPTGT_ATRB_ID, 'Operative Facility Opening Table DepartureGate' , TO_CHAR(NVL(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, A.FRST_REG_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'), 'cols_DepartureGate' FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_DPTGT_MSTR A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL SELECT 'GenericTable', 'FacilityOpeningTable_Immigration' || A.ENTCNY_ATRB_ID, 'Operative Facility Opening Table Immigration' , TO_CHAR(NVL(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, A.FRST_REG_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'), 'cols_Immigration' FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_ENTCNY_MSTR A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL SELECT 'GenericTable', 'FacilityOpeningTable_Emigration' || A.DPTCNY_ATRB_ID, 'Operative Facility Opening Table Emigration' , TO_CHAR(NVL(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, A.FRST_REG_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'), 'cols_Emigration' FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_DPTCNY_MSTR A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL SELECT 'GenericTable', 'FacilityOpeningTable_SecurityControl' || A.SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID, 'Operative Facility Opening Table SecurityControl' , TO_CHAR(NVL(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, A.FRST_REG_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'), 'cols_SecurityControl' FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_SCRTY_CNTRL_MSTR A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL SELECT 'GenericTable', 'FacilityOpeningTable_TransferSecurityControl' || A.TRNST_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID, 'Operative Facility Opening Table TrasnferSecurityControl' , TO_CHAR(NVL(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, A.FRST_REG_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'), 'cols_SecurityTransferControl' FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_TRNST_SCRTY_CNTRL_MSTR A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL SELECT 'GenericTable', 'ReportingProfilesTimeGroups' || A.RPT_STNG_ATRB_ID, 'Reporting Profiles Time Groups' , TO_CHAR(NVL(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, A.FRST_REG_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'), 'cols_ReportingProfilesTimeGroups' FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RPT_STNG_HR_GROUP_MSTR A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'

) R ORDER BY R.ResourceType DESC

WITH /* 2) 기준 운항 집합 */ FLT AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN A.DOM_INTL_SE_CD = 'I' THEN 'Int' WHEN A.DOM_INTL_SE_CD = 'D' THEN 'Dom' ELSE '' END AS DOM_INT_SE_CD, A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, A.TMNL_ID AS CF_TER_ID_X, A.ALN_CD, A.GD_SE_YMD AS SCHD_DT, A.SCHDL_HM AS SCHD_HM, A.FLTNM AS FLT_NM, A.FLTSH_ID AS FLT_ID, A.FLTNM || '_' || SUBSTR(A.GD_SE_YMD, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(A.GD_SE_YMD, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(A.GD_SE_YMD, 7, 2) || 'T' || SUBSTR(A.SCHDL_HM, 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.SCHDL_HM, 3, 2) || ':00.000' AS FLT_NM_ID, SUBSTR(A.GD_SE_YMD, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(A.GD_SE_YMD, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(A.GD_SE_YMD, 7, 2) || 'T' || SUBSTR(A.SCHDL_HM, 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.SCHDL_HM, 3, 2) || ':00.000' AS SCHD_TIME, A.FS_GD_DT + A.FS_SCHD_MIN / 1440 AS SCHD_DTM, /* 계획보다 12시간 넘게 이른 예측 · 실제 시각은 자정을 넘긴 다음 날로 본다 */ A.FS_GD_DT + (A.FS_PREDC_MIN + CASE WHEN A.FS_PREDC_MIN < A.FS_SCHD_MIN - 720 THEN 1440 ELSE 0 END) / 1440 AS ESTM_DTM, A.FS_GD_DT + (A.FS_ACTL_MIN + CASE WHEN A.FS_ACTL_MIN < A.FS_SCHD_MIN - 720 THEN 1440 ELSE 0 END) / 1440 AS ACTL_DTM, A.ARPT_CD AS ARR_DEP_APT_CD, NULLIF(TRIM(A.ACST_NO), '') AS STND_NO_RAW, NULLIF(TRIM(A.GATE_NO), '') AS GATE_NO_RAW, TO_NUMBER(A.ARCFT_STGCP) AS AC_SEAT_CNT, CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(A.PFR_BRDG_TNOPE) + TO_NUMBER(A.FREE_BRDG_TNOPE) + TO_NUMBER(A.TRNS_BRDG_TNOPE) > 0 THEN TO_NUMBER(A.PFR_BRDG_TNOPE) + TO_NUMBER(A.FREE_BRDG_TNOPE) + TO_NUMBER(A.TRNS_BRDG_TNOPE) ELSE TO_NUMBER(A.RSVT_BDPSG_CNT) END AS PAX_CNT, CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(A.PFR_BRDG_TNOPE) + TO_NUMBER(A.FREE_BRDG_TNOPE) + TO_NUMBER(A.TRNS_BRDG_TNOPE) > 0 THEN TO_NUMBER(A.TRNS_BRDG_TNOPE) ELSE TO_NUMBER(A.RSVT_TRNS_BDPSG_CNT) END AS TR_PAX_CNT, CASE WHEN TRIM(A.CRSL_NO) = '0' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(A.CRSL_NO), '') END AS CRS_NO_RAW, A.ARCFT_SUBTYPE_CD AS AC_TYPE, CASE WHEN A.GD_IRR_YN IN ('0', 'N') THEN 'Schedule' WHEN A.GD_IRR_YN IN ('1', 'Y') THEN 'Charter' ELSE '' END AS IRR_FLT_YN, A.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, TRIM(A.PREDC_HM) AS PREDC_HM, TRIM(A.ACTL_HM) AS ACTL_HM, A.GD_IRR_YN, A.RSVT_BDPSG_CNT, A.RSVT_TRNS_BDPSG_CNT FROM ( SELECT A.*, TO_DATE(A.GD_SE_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD') AS FS_GD_DT, TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(A.SCHDL_HM, 1, 2)) * 60 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(A.SCHDL_HM, 3, 2)) AS FS_SCHD_MIN, TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(A.PREDC_HM), 1, 2)) * 60 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(A.PREDC_HM), 3, 2)) AS FS_PREDC_MIN, TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(A.ACTL_HM), 1, 2)) * 60 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(A.ACTL_HM), 3, 2)) AS FS_ACTL_MIN FROM GOOWN.TN_GO_GD_DATA A WHERE A.GD_SE_YMD = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMMDD')
) A ), /* 9) 편별 체크인카운터 범위(D01-D18) - 아일랜드가 갈리면 카운터가 많은 아일랜드 하나 */ CIC_RANGE AS ( /* 순위 = 카운터 수 많은 아일랜드 → 아일랜드 이름. 1순위 아일랜드의 처음 · 끝 카운터 */ SELECT G.FLT_ID, MIN(G.MIN_CKNCT_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY G.CKNCT_CNT DESC, G.ISL) || '-' || MAX(G.MAX_CKNCT_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY G.CKNCT_CNT DESC, G.ISL) AS CIC_RANGE_CTT FROM ( /* 8) 편별 배정 카운터 - 출발 2시간 전에 열려 있는 같은 터미널의 항공사(C) 배정 */ SELECT B.FLT_ID, SUBSTR(AL.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) AS ISL, COUNT(DISTINCT AL.CKNCT_ID) AS CKNCT_CNT, MIN(AL.CKNCT_ID) AS MIN_CKNCT_ID, MAX(AL.CKNCT_ID) AS MAX_CKNCT_ID FROM ( SELECT FLT_ID, ALN_CD, CASE WHEN CF_TER_ID_X = 'P02' THEN 'P01' ELSE CF_TER_ID_X END AS CIC_TMNL_ID, TO_DATE(SCHD_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') + (TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(SCHD_HM, 1, 2)) * 60 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(SCHD_HM, 3, 2)) - 120) / 1440 AS CK_DT FROM FLT WHERE ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'D' AND FLT_ID IS NOT NULL ) B /* 7) 체크인카운터 배정 - CA001 과 같은 원천 · 필터 */ JOIN () AL ON B.CK_DT >= AL.BGN_DT AND B.CK_DT < AL.END_DT AND AL.CHKN_TYPE_CD = 'C' AND AL.ALN_CD = B.ALN_CD AND AL.TMNL_ID = B.CIC_TMNL_ID GROUP BY B.FLT_ID, SUBSTR(AL.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) ) G GROUP BY G.FLT_ID ), /* 12) 최근 3개월 기준 편명 · 출도착 · 터미널(T1/T2)별 대표 gate/stnd */ PAST_GATE AS ( SELECT FLT_NM, ARR_DEP_SE_CD, TMNL_GRP, STND_NO, GATE_NO FROM ( SELECT A.FLTNM AS FLT_NM, A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, CASE WHEN A.TMNL_ID = 'P03' THEN 'T2' ELSE 'T1' END AS TMNL_GRP, A.ACST_NO AS STND_NO, A.GATE_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.FLTNM, A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, CASE WHEN A.TMNL_ID = 'P03' THEN 'T2' ELSE 'T1' END ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(A.GD_SE_YMD) DESC, A.GATE_NO, A.ACST_NO ) AS RN FROM GOOWN.TN_GO_GD_DATA A WHERE A.GD_SE_YMD BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD'), - 3), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
AND A.TMNL_ID IS NOT NULL AND A.TMNL_ID != 'P' AND A.ACST_NO IS NOT NULL AND A.ACST_NO != '0000' AND A.GATE_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY A.FLTNM, A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, CASE WHEN A.TMNL_ID = 'P03' THEN 'T2' ELSE 'T1' END, A.ACST_NO, A.GATE_NO ) WHERE RN = 1 ), /* 15) 기준 운항 + 과거 대표값 + FP/RS/CIC 결합 */ FLT_RSRC AS ( SELECT F.*, CASE WHEN F.STND_NO_RAW IS NOT NULL AND F.STND_NO_RAW != '0000' THEN F.STND_NO_RAW WHEN PG.STND_NO IS NOT NULL THEN PG.STND_NO ELSE '112' END AS STND_NO, CASE WHEN F.GATE_NO_RAW IS NOT NULL THEN F.GATE_NO_RAW WHEN PG.GATE_NO IS NOT NULL THEN PG.GATE_NO WHEN PG.STND_NO IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(PG.STND_NO, 'L', ''), 'R', '') ELSE '112' END AS GATE_NO, CASE WHEN F.GATE_NO_RAW IS NULL AND PG.GATE_NO IS NULL AND PG.STND_NO IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS GATE_DFLT_YN, CASE WHEN F.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'A' THEN COALESCE(F.ACTL_DTM, F.ESTM_DTM, F.SCHD_DTM) END AS ARR_DT, COALESCE(F.CRS_NO_RAW, RCD.CRS_NO) AS CRS_NO_BASE, CR.CIC_RANGE_CTT FROM FLT F LEFT JOIN PAST_GATE PG ON F.FLT_NM = PG.FLT_NM AND F.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = PG.ARR_DEP_SE_CD AND CASE WHEN F.CF_TER_ID_X = 'P03' THEN 'T2' ELSE 'T1' END = PG.TMNL_GRP LEFT JOIN ( /* 11) RS 캐로셀 정보 */ SELECT ARR_DALY_FLTSH_ID AS ARR_ACT_FLT_ID, MIN(CASE WHEN CRSL_NO = '0' THEN NULL ELSE CRSL_NO END) AS CRS_NO FROM GOOWN.TI_GO_CRSL_DALY_OPER WHERE ALTMNT_YMD BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY ARR_DALY_FLTSH_ID ) RCD ON F.FLT_ID = RCD.ARR_ACT_FLT_ID LEFT JOIN CIC_RANGE CR ON F.FLT_ID = CR.FLT_ID ) /* 16) 최종 FFF */ SELECT R.DOM_INT_SE_CD AS DomStatus, R.ARR_DEP_SE_CD AS FlightDirection, COALESCE(CASE WHEN R.GATE_DFLT_YN = 'N' THEN GI.TER_ID END, R.CF_TER_ID_X) AS DepArrTerminal, R.ALN_CD AS AirlineCode, /* 3) 항공사 카테고리 */ CASE WHEN NVL((SELECT MAX(AL.LCC_YN) FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_ALN AL WHERE AL.ALN_CD = R.ALN_CD), 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'LCC' ELSE 'FSC' END AS OperatorCat, R.FLT_NM AS FlightNumber, R.FLT_NM_ID AS FlightNumberID, R.SCHD_TIME AS ScheduleTime, TO_CHAR(R.ESTM_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI":00.000"') AS EstimatedTime, TO_CHAR(R.ACTL_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI":00.000"') AS ActualTime, R.ARR_DEP_APT_CD AS AirportCode, LPAD(REGEXP_SUBSTR(R.STND_NO, '^[0-9]+'), 3, '0') || REGEXP_SUBSTR(R.STND_NO, '[^0-9]+$') AS StandNumber, LPAD(REGEXP_SUBSTR(R.GATE_NO, '^[0-9]+'), 3, '0') || REGEXP_SUBSTR(R.GATE_NO, '[^0-9]+$') AS Gate, /* 5) 게이트 타입 */ NVL((SELECT MIN(AC.ACST_TYPE_CD) FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_ACST AC WHERE AC.USE_YN = 'Y' AND AC.GATE_NO = R.GATE_NO), 'E') AS ContactRemote, R.AC_SEAT_CNT AS Seats, R.PAX_CNT AS PaxCount, CASE WHEN R.TR_PAX_CNT > R.PAX_CNT THEN R.PAX_CNT -- 환승객이 전체 승객보다 많으면 전체 승객수로 제한 ELSE R.TR_PAX_CNT END AS TransferPax, CASE WHEN R.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'A' THEN COALESCE( R.CRS_NO_BASE, AH.CRS_NO, CCP.CRS_NO, '' ) ELSE '' END AS Belt, R.AC_TYPE AS AircraftType, R.CIC_RANGE_CTT AS CheckinRange, /* 6) 셀프체크인 가능 항공사 -> 영어 이름대로 셀프백드랍으로 변경 */ CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SBD_OPER_PLCY P WHERE P.ALN_CD = R.ALN_CD AND P.TMNL_ID = CASE WHEN R.CF_TER_ID_X = 'P02' THEN 'P01' ELSE R.CF_TER_ID_X END AND TO_TIMESTAMP(P.PLCY_BGNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') < TO_TIMESTAMP(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD') + INTERVAL '1' DAY AND TO_TIMESTAMP(P.PLCY_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD') ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SBDAvailable, R.IRR_FLT_YN AS FlightType, 'N' AS Triangle, 'N' AS BUS, CASE WHEN R.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'A' THEN DECODE(COALESCE(CASE WHEN R.GATE_DFLT_YN = 'N' THEN GI.TER_ID END, R.CF_TER_ID_X), 'P01', 'E', 'P02', 'D', 'P03', 'A') END AS ArrivalGate, TO_CHAR(R.ARR_DT + 20 / 1440, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI":00.000"') AS BaggageT1, TO_CHAR(R.ARR_DT + 40 / 1440, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI":00.000"') AS BaggageT2, R.CF_TER_ID_X, R.SCHD_DT, R.SCHD_HM, R.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, R.PREDC_HM, R.ACTL_HM, R.GD_IRR_YN, R.RSVT_BDPSG_CNT, R.RSVT_TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, TO_CHAR(R.ARR_DT + 20 / 1440, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') AS FRST_BAG_INPUT_DT_RAW, TO_CHAR(R.ARR_DT + 40 / 1440, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI') AS LAST_BAG_INPUT_DT_RAW FROM FLT_RSRC R /* 4) 게이트 -> 터미널/CRS 그룹 */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT GATE_NO, MAX(TMNL_ID) AS TER_ID, MAX(CRSL_GROUP_CD) AS CRS_GRP_CD FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_GATE GROUP BY GATE_NO ) GI ON R.GATE_NO = GI.GATE_NO /* 13) 최근 1개월 도착편 기준 대표 캐로셀 */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT A.FLTNM AS FLT_NM, A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, A.GATE_NO, A.ACST_NO AS STND_NO, A.CRSL_NO AS CRS_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.FLTNM, A.GATE_NO, A.ACST_NO ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(A.GD_SE_YMD) DESC, A.CRSL_NO ) AS RN FROM GOOWN.TN_GO_GD_DATA A WHERE A.GD_SE_YMD BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD'), - 1), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fsYmd}, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = 'A'
AND A.CRSL_NO != '0' AND TRIM(A.GATE_NO) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(A.CRSL_NO) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY A.FLTNM, A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, A.GATE_NO, A.ACST_NO, A.CRSL_NO ) AH ON AH.RN = 1 AND R.FLT_NM = AH.FLT_NM AND R.GATE_NO = AH.GATE_NO AND R.STND_NO = AH.STND_NO AND R.ARR_DEP_SE_CD = AH.ARR_DEP_SE_CD /* 14) CA_CRS fallback - TER_ID(+P02->P01), CRS_GRP_CD별 1건 */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CASE WHEN TMNL_ID = 'P02' THEN 'P01' ELSE TMNL_ID END AS TER_ID_ADJ, CRSL_GROUP_CD AS CRS_GRP_CD, CRSL_NO AS CRS_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN TMNL_ID = 'P02' THEN 'P01' ELSE TMNL_ID END, CRSL_GROUP_CD ORDER BY CRSL_NO ) AS RN FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_CRSL ) CCP ON CCP.RN = 1 AND CCP.TER_ID_ADJ = CASE WHEN GI.TER_ID = 'P02' THEN 'P01' ELSE GI.TER_ID END AND CCP.CRS_GRP_CD = GI.CRS_GRP_CD

A.FCLTY_TYPE_ID = 'E' THEN '-' || 'East' ELSE '' END AS location , REPLACE(CASE WHEN A.OPER_BGNG_HM IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(D.EXCN_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || 'T00:00:00.000' WHEN A.OPER_BGNG_HM IS NOT NULL THEN '1899-12-30T' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.OPER_BGNG_HM || '00', 'HH24MISS'),'HH24:MI:SS') || '.000' WHEN B.OPER_BGNG_1_HR IS NOT NULL THEN '1899-12-30T' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(B.OPER_BGNG_1_HR || '00', 'HH24:MI:SS'),'HH24:MI:SS') || '.000' ELSE '1899-12-30T00:00:00.000' END, ' ', '') AS startTime , REPLACE(CASE WHEN A.OPER_END_HM IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(D.EXCN_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || 'T00:00:00.000' WHEN B.OPER_END_1_HR IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NVL(B.END_YMD,'21001231'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || 'T00:00:00.000' ELSE '2100-12-31T00:00:00.000' END, ' ', '') AS endDate , REPLACE(CASE WHEN A.OPER_END_HM IS NOT NULL THEN '1899-12-30T' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.OPER_END_HM || '00', 'HH24MISS'),'HH24:MI:SS') || '.000' WHEN B.OPER_END_1_HR IS NOT NULL THEN '1899-12-30T' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(B.OPER_END_1_HR || '00', 'HH24:MI:SS'),'HH24:MI:SS') || '.000' ELSE '1899-12-30T23:59:00.000' SELECT TO_CHAR(A.SCHDL_HR) AS scheduledHour , A.GROUP_NM AS groupName , (SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(M.LAST_MDFCN_DT, M.FRST_REG_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RPT_STNG_HR_GROUP_MSTR M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.RPT_STNG_ATRB_ID = #{rsrcNo}) AS lastModified FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RPT_STNG_HR_GROUP_ATRB A WHERE A.RPT_STNG_ATRB_ID = #{rsrcNo} ORDER BY A.SCHDL_HR, A.GROUP_NM

/* CastApiMapper.retrieveWhatIfCntrl(CastReqGetResourceDto dto) */ -- 상태와 관계없이 전체 요청을 내보낸다. CAST 가 돌려보낸 상태 목록에 없는 요청은 삭제되므로 여기서 거르면 진행 중인 요청이 지워진다. -- 빈 칸은 ' ' 로 채운다 (Java 가 컬럼마다 행 값을 이어 붙인다). SELECT NVL(SMLT_REQ_ID,' ') AS whatIfRunId , NVL(MDL_RSRC_ID,' ') AS model , NVL(FLT_SCHDL_RSRC_ID,' ') AS fs , NVL(CKNCT_ALCTN_RSRC_ID,' ') AS ca , NVL(SBD_CNTRL_ALCTN_ID,' ') AS sbd , NVL(PRPT_STNG_RSRC_ID,' ') AS ps , NVL(FCLTY_OPNG_DPTCNY_SRNG_RSRC_ID,' ') AS facilityOpeningTableDepartureGate , NVL(FCLTY_OPNG_DPTCNY_RSRC_ID,' ') AS facilityOpeningTableEmigration , NVL(FCLTY_OPNG_ENTCNY_RSRC_ID,' ') AS facilityOpeningTableImmigration , NVL(FCLTY_OPNG_SCRTY_CNTRL_RSRC_ID,' ') AS facilityOpeningTableSecurityControl , NVL(FCLTY_OPNG_TR_SCRTY_CNTRL_RSRC_ID,' ') AS facilityOpeningTableTransferSecurityControl , NVL(CKNCT_SRVC_HR_RSRC_ID,' ') AS checkinCounterServiceTime , NVL(CHKN_TYPE_RSRC_ID,' ') AS checkinType , NVL(RPT_STNG_ATRB_ID,' ') AS rptStngId , NVL(SMLT_REQ_ID,' ') AS simulationResultSuffix , NVL(SMLT_STTS,' ') AS status , NVL(TO_CHAR(NVL(LAST_MDFCN_DT,FRST_REG_DT),'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'),' ') AS lastChange , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS lastModified FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR ORDER BY SMLT_REQ_ID
/* CastApiMapper.checkFcltCdList(SimRsltDto dto) */ SELECT PSG_FCLT_CD AS psgFcltCd , SMLT_FCLT_NM AS smltFcltNm FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: /* CastApiMapper.insertSimResultDtlRegExcl(SmltRsltDtlDto dto) */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL_REG_EXCL ( SMLT_ID , SMLT_SN , PSG_FCLT_EXPLN , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR , FRST_REG_DT) SELECT #{smltId} , (SELECT NVL(MAX(SMLT_SN),0) + 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL_REG_EXCL WHERE SMLT_ID = #{smltId}) , #{psgFcltDesc} , 'CAST' , #{loginIpAddr} , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM DUAL

/* CastApiMapper.insertAtchFile(PmAtchFileDto dto) */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_PSG_MNG_ATFL /* 첨부파일 */ (ATCH_FILE_ID /* 첨부파일ID */ , ATCH_FILE_SN /* 첨부파일일련번호 */ , ATCH_FILE_TASK_SE_CD /* 첨부파일업무구분코드 */ , ATCH_FILE_TYPE_CD /* 첨부파일유형코드 */ , STRG_FILE_NM /* 저장파일명 */ , ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM /* 첨부파일경로명 */ , ATCH_FILE_SZ /* 첨부파일사이즈 */ , ATCH_FILE_EXTN_NM /* 첨부파일확장자명 */ , ATCH_FILE_EXPLN /* 첨부파일설명 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자ID */ , FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR /* 최초등록자IP */ , FRST_REG_DT) /* 최초등록타임스탬프 */ VALUES ( #{atchFileId} /* 첨부파일ID */ , #{atchFileSn} /* 첨부파일일련번호 */ , #{atchFileTaskSeCd} /* 첨부파일업무구분코드 */ , #{atchFileTypeCd} /* 첨부파일유형코드 */ , #{strgFileNm} /* 저장파일명 */ , #{atchFilePathNm} /* 첨부파일경로명 */ , #{atchFileSz} /* 첨부파일사이즈 */ , 'txt' /* 첨부파일확장자명 */ , '----' /* 첨부파일설명 */ , #{loginUserId} /* 최초등록자ID */ , #{loginIpAddr} /* 최초등록자IP */ , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) /* 최초등록타임스탬프 */
mapper.select: /* CastApiMapper.retrieveIdMaxPk() */ SELECT DECODE(SUBSTR(MAX(ATCH_FILE_ID), 1, 8) , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), SUBSTR(MAX(ATCH_FILE_ID), 1, 8) || LPAD(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(MAX(ATCH_FILE_ID), 9, 11)) + 1, 3, '0') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '001') AS atchFileId FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_PSG_MNG_ATFL
/* CastApiMapper.checkWhatIfIdList(CastWhatIfCntrlDto dto) */ SELECT SMLT_REQ_ID AS whatIfRunId , SMLT_STTS AS status FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_MSTR
